title: Sheafification commutes with restriction to a dense subsite
statement: Let $u:\mathcal C\to\mathcal D$ be a fully faithful functor, let $K$ be a Grothendieck topology on $\mathcal D$ such that every object of $\mathcal D$ has a $K$-covering sieve generated by morphisms from objects $u(U)$, $U\in\mathcal C$, and give $\mathcal C$ the topology $J$ induced by $u$: a sieve $R$ on $U$ is $J$-covering iff the sieve on $u(U)$ generated by the $u(r)$, $r\in R$, is $K$-covering. Let $\mathcal V$ be a category (for example sets or abelian groups) such that sheafification of $\mathcal V$-valued presheaves exists on $(\mathcal C,J)$ and on $(\mathcal D,K)$, and suppose restriction $\mathcal G\mapsto\mathcal G\circ u^{op}$ is an equivalence $\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal D,K;\mathcal V)\xrightarrow{\sim}\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal C,J;\mathcal V)$. Then for every presheaf $F$ on $\mathcal D$ with values in $\mathcal V$, with sheafifications $(-)^{\#}$ as in [def-weil-pbc-sheafification], there is an isomorphism $(F\circ u^{op})^{\#}\cong F^{\#}\circ u^{op}$ of sheaves on $(\mathcal C,J)$, natural in $F$.
